documents.title: Published Dragonfly objects in plugin object pickers / 对象选择列表
documents.text:
Project engineering note: Object selection lists should enumerate Class.getAllRepresentableInstances().
getAllInstances() can include internal or intermediate objects hidden by Dragonfly's own object list.
For a user-facing list of Channels, ROIs, MultiROIs or Meshes, use the representable instances API.
getAllInstances() remains useful for resolving a previously chosen GUID or housekeeping that intentionally sees all objects.
This note reflects Prototype Labs engineering guidance; check the installed version's Python API before copying code.
中文：插件对象选择列表应使用 getAllRepresentableInstances()，避免把隐藏的内部对象列给用户。

documents.title: Python source inspection versus native implementation / 源码查询边界
documents.text:
Readable Python modules can explain wrappers, plugin menus and Python-side UI behavior.
A call ending in a compiled .pyd or .dll does not expose the native implementation.
Report the visible interface and the boundary; do not invent the hidden algorithm.
Separate the installed version's Help, Python source and example scripts in the knowledge corpus.
Locally readable source does not establish redistribution permission. Import authorized local files into a user-owned corpus.
中文：查询 Dragonfly 源码时，应说明 Python 包装层与原生编译代码的边界，并标记资料版本。

documents.title: External Python environment diagnostics / 外部 Python 环境排错
documents.text:
When a plugin launches an external Python interpreter, inspect inherited PYTHONHOME and PYTHONPATH.
Those variables can point the external interpreter at a different Python version's standard library.
Errors such as SRE module mismatch can be an environment contamination symptom rather than a missing package.
Probe a candidate interpreter for venv, ensurepip, pyexpat and pip before choosing it as a venv base.
Check each plugin's documented Python and wheel support; the base version need not match Dragonfly when computation runs in a separate process.
These are diagnostics, not a universal fix; obtain version-specific evidence before prescribing a concrete interpreter.
中文：外部 Python 报错时检查继承的环境变量、基础解释器功能和该插件的依赖兼容性。
